summary: No open skull-shape dataset for the claim's taxa was found: MorphoSource keyword counts are 0 for Homo erectus, Neanderthal, Mesopithecus and Hominidae (34 for Pan troglodytes), Dryad has no hominin landmark set, and Zenodo yields only paper supplements. Independent branching information is available as phylogenetic infrastructure (Open Tree of Life resolves all four names; GenBank holds molecular records for living Hominidae), but neither carries skull morphology, and the claim's test needs cranial transformation data for fossils.
next_step: Compile a landmark table for Mesopithecus, H. erectus, Neanderthal, modern human and ape skulls from published supplements or from a fossil-hominin repository with access terms, and pre-register the series-vs-branching error comparison; use Open Tree of Life only as the reference topology.
